---
title: inif.converters.text
description: Build INIF documents from raw text strings or text files on disk.
reference: inif.converters.text
---

The fastest path from "I have some strings" to "I have an `InifDocument`".
Handles plain strings and chat-style message lists; chat detection is
per-element. See [the text converter guide](../converters/text.qmd) for
options and conventions.

## Entry points

### from_texts

### from_text_files
